title: [Latest DEV] No BG value is shown in NS when BG Source is xDrip
symptom: When BG source is xDrip and NS upload/download is disabled in xDrip, AAPS does not upload BG values to Nightscout. The BG value is not shown in NS, even though NSV3 indicates the value is sent. Other users report similar issues with xDrip as source for Libre 2 and no BG readings for 37 minutes.
fix: Resolved in dev-k (per maintainer comment). No specific configuration details provided.
